*Hetuduka, Atītārammaṇattika* (Patthana 15.19) is a canonical section of the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Pali Canon. The text analyzes the conditional relations (*paccaya*) operating between phenomena categorized under the combination of the Root Dyad (*hetuduka*) and the Past-Object Triad (*atītārammaṇattika*).
